texts.en:
Recent advances in Computing research have led to the invention of Detection Arrays. Installing these high-powered external sensors on our Starbases will grant the ability to detect Cloaked fleets.

The sensitivity of the Detection Arrays can be increased by coupling multiple arrays together, allowing them to penetrate increasingly stable Cloaking Fields.

With further research, we should be able to use £science_ship£ Science Ships to further increase boost these detection capabilities. The range of these devices is limited by the starbase's Sensor Range.
